title: AI Copilot
description: Sheet-mode AI panel: natural language to formulas, explanations, data analysis, and previewed sheet edits — common requests answered locally with no API key.

title: Color scales
description: Gradient conditional formatting: cell background shades scale with the cell's numeric value across the selected range.

title: Conditional formatting
description: Rule-based cell styling: apply a style to cells in a range when a condition matches.

title: Cross-sheet references
description: Formulas can reference cells on other sheets in the same workbook: =Sheet2!A1.

title: Data bars
description: In-cell proportional bars: each cell draws a horizontal bar sized relative to the range's largest magnitude.

title: Data validation
description: Restrict what a range accepts: dropdown lists of allowed values and checkboxes.

title: Dynamic arrays and spill
description: Array formulas whose results spill into neighbouring cells: FILTER, SORT, UNIQUE, SEQUENCE, QUERY, TRANSPOSE, ARRAYFORMULA and friends.

title: Filter views
description: Header filter buttons over a range: per-column value checklists that hide non-matching rows, plus sort A→Z / Z→A.

title: Find and replace
description: Search cell contents across the sheet and replace matches.

title: Freeze panes
description: Keep header rows/columns visible while scrolling: freeze 1–2 rows/columns or up to the current row/column.

title: Google Sheets sync
description: Two-way sync with a real Google Sheet via an Apps Script /exec endpoint, with direction and conflict-policy controls.

title: IMPORTRANGE (cross-workbook)
description: Pull a range from another Mono workbook: =IMPORTRANGE(source_key, "Sheet!A1:B2").

title: LAMBDA and LET
description: Functional formulas: define inline functions with LAMBDA, name intermediate values with LET, and map/reduce over ranges.

title: Merge cells
description: Merge a selected range into one cell — all, horizontally (per row), or vertically (per column) — and unmerge.

title: Mono Scripts
description: Apps-Script-style JavaScript automation: custom menus, onOpen/onEdit triggers, and custom formula functions.

title: Named ranges
description: Give a range a name and use that name in formulas instead of A1 coordinates.

title: Protected ranges
description: Block edits to a range until it is explicitly unprotected (single-user protect, not collaborator permissions).

title: Multi-view system
description: Show the same sheet data as Grid, Kanban, Calendar, Gallery, or Form — with per-view filters, sorts, and grouping.
